brief_summary: This study is a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial aimed at exploring the effects of LAE102 injection in combination with Tirzepatide on body composition.
brief_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study Evaluating the Effect of LAE102 Injection in Combination With Tirzepatide on Body in Obese Participants
official_title: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study Evaluating the Effect of LAE102 Injection in Combination With Tirzepatide on Body Composition in Obese Participants

primary_outcomes.measure: The percentage change in lean body mass
